import os

from amazon_nova_api import NovaDocumentClient


def get_document_client():
    api_key = os.getenv('NOVA_API_KEY')
    client = NovaDocumentClient(api_key=api_key)
    return client


def extract_document(document_id):
    client = get_document_client()
    document = client.extract(document_id)
    return document

import boto3

def normalize_expense(expense_data):
    lambda_client = boto3.client('lambda')
    response = lambda_client.invoke(
        FunctionName='expense-normalization-function',
        InvocationType='RequestResponse',
        Payload=json.dumps(expense_data)
    )
    payload = json.loads(response['Payload'].read())
    return payload
